title: Scope directive snapshot reads; skip sync probe for read-only commands
description: buildCliAgentDirectiveSnapshot loads every work item, edge, evidence, verification, summary, and reservation and runs a full sync probe (vault+ledger+search+git) per command. Scope reads to the subject subtree; skip the probe for read-only commands or reuse an in-process snapshot.
acceptanceCriteria: Read-only commands run no vault/ledger/search/git probe for directive compilation
Directive snapshot loads only subject-subtree records; behavior parity covered by existing directive tests
